name: François Girard
biography: François Girard is an actor, stuntman, screenwriter and director, originally from Loire Atlantique. He moved to Paris to study drama at the Cours Florent for three years. In his final year, he directed his own play and made a short film, in which he also acted. He became aware of his true passion for cinema, creation and acting. In recent years he has been involved in numerous film and television shoots, as well as advertising. He also trained as a stuntman, highlighting his martial arts skills. Additionally, he also provides voice-over dubbing training, as well as Cossack acrobatics. In parallel, he continues to make short films, which are selected several times at different international festivals and win some awards.
